scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.check:api-contracts: node --test scripts/api-contracts/runtime-route-parity.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- lib/api-client-react/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/generated
scripts.audit:backend: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run audit && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/dashboard-after-scan.test.ts e2e/cleanup-execute.test.ts
